decisions.reason: A classic lever handle launched only a year ago costs little to keep in a large catalogue, and its prospects are not yet resolved, so the option stays open.
The handle family fits the firm's push toward system families, upkeep is cheap, and one year of results is too little to justify abandoning it.
A single new handle design is a low-cost option whose market value is still uncertain, so keeping it on the market is worthwhile.
Like C, this design option costs little to hold and has shown no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.
The lever handle family supports system breadth at modest holding cost while its uncertainty is still resolving.
The flagship electronic access system anchors the firm's digital building organization direction and is a high-upside option that warrants further commitment.
